data.exact_reserve_text: The run-off improvement for Syndicate 2243 relating to prior year's business was GBP 3.3m. This was mainly attributable to the Construction class which improved by GBP 2.6m following better than expected claims experience in 2014.
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2243 reported a net prior year reserve release of GBP 3.3 million for the year ended 31 December 2014, representing a 3.81% release against opening gross reserves. This run-off improvement was primarily driven by favourable claims development in the Construction class, contributing GBP 2.6 million, and other Casualty classes, where ultimate loss ratios reduced due to better than expected claims experience.
raw_causal_phrases: run-off improvement for Syndicate 2243 relating to prior year's business
mainly attributable to the Construction class which improved by GBP 2.6m following better than expected claims experience in 2014
strong performances in both the Construction and Casualty classes, where ultimate loss ratios have reduced following favourable claims experience over the year

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of -GBP 3.3m is stated as 'run-off improvement' and is assumed to be net of reinsurance as not explicitly stated as gross. The breakdown of the remaining GBP 0.7m release for Casualty is inferred.
